query: Create a complete governance-evidence package for production Snowflake datasets in DataHub, covering ownership, documentation, domain, field classification, and one-hop upstream lineage.
expected_behavior: Fixes and records the exact DataHub boundary before collecting evidence
Prefers available DataHub MCP read tools and records their exact names and pagination sequence
Collects every selected asset without sampling and uses exact returned URNs for retrieval
Assigns only Observed, Not observed, or Unable to determine states
Produces matching Markdown and JSON with complete URN populations and the fixed disclaimer
Runs the deterministic package validator before delivery
Does not write metadata or issue a score, grade, readiness rating, or compliance determination
